# Infrastructure Consultant Bureau (ICB)

> Engineering the frameworks that carry tomorrow

## About

Infrastructure Consultant Bureau (ICB) is a civil engineering and infrastructure consulting firm specializing in the design and engineering of bridges, roads, flyovers, and structural systems. ICB is founded and led by Supriyolal Bandyopadhyay.

## Founder

- **Name**: Supriyolal Bandyopadhyay
- **Role**: Founder & Lead Consultant
- **Organization**: Infrastructure Consultant Bureau (ICB)

## Services

- Bridge Design & Engineering
- Road Infrastructure Planning
- Flyover Design & Construction Consulting
- Structural Engineering & Analysis
- Infrastructure Consulting
